import json
from pathlib import Path

import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import matplotlib.ticker as mticker
import numpy as np

src = Path('/app/benchmark/source_data.json')
out = Path('/app/output/result.png')
out.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

with src.open() as f:
    data = json.load(f)

lcoe = data['lcoe_trends']['data']
fossil = data['fossil_fuel_lcoe_range']['data']
cap = data['installed_capacity']['data']
subs = data['fossil_fuel_subsidies']['data']

years = np.array([d['year'] for d in lcoe])
solar = np.array([d['solar_pv'] for d in lcoe])
wind = np.array([d['onshore_wind'] for d in lcoe])
battery = np.array([d['battery_storage'] for d in lcoe])

f_years = np.array([d['year'] for d in fossil])
f_low = np.array([min(d['gas_ccgt_low'], d['coal_low']) for d in fossil])
f_high = np.array([max(d['gas_ccgt_high'], d['coal_high']) for d in fossil])

cap_years = np.array([d['year'] for d in cap])
solar_gw = np.array([d['solar_pv_gw'] for d in cap])
wind_gw = np.array([d['onshore_wind_gw'] for d in cap])

sub_years = np.array([d['year'] for d in subs])
cons = np.array([d['consumption_subsidies_bn'] for d in subs])
prod = np.array([d['production_subsidies_bn'] for d in subs])
total = np.array([d['total_subsidies_bn'] for d in subs])

# Crossover against lower edge of the fossil generation range. Fossil series is biennial;
# interpolate solely between provided benchmark years for annual crossover identification.
f_low_annual = np.interp(years, f_years, f_low)
solar_cross = int(years[np.where(solar < f_low_annual)[0][0]])
wind_cross = int(years[np.where(wind < f_low_annual)[0][0]])

colors = {
    'solar': '#E69F00',
    'wind': '#0072B2',
    'battery': '#6A3D9A',
    'fossil': '#6B625A',
    'fossil_fill': '#B7AEA4',
    'sub_cons': '#8C6D31',
    'sub_prod': '#C9A66B',
    'grid': '#D8D3CC',
    'text': '#24211F',
}

plt.rcParams.update({
    'figure.dpi': 180,
    'savefig.dpi': 220,
    'font.family': 'DejaVu Sans',
    'axes.edgecolor': '#BDB6AD',
    'axes.labelcolor': colors['text'],
    'xtick.color': colors['text'],
    'ytick.color': colors['text'],
    'text.color': colors['text'],
    'axes.titleweight': 'bold',
})

fig = plt.figure(figsize=(14, 10), facecolor='#F7F3EC')
gs = fig.add_gridspec(3, 1, height_ratios=[1.52, 1.08, 0.95], hspace=0.18)
ax1 = fig.add_subplot(gs[0])
ax2 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1], sharex=ax1)
ax3 = fig.add_subplot(gs[2], sharex=ax1)

for ax in (ax1, ax2, ax3):
    ax.set_facecolor('#F7F3EC')
    ax.grid(True, axis='y', color=colors['grid'], lw=0.8, alpha=0.75)
    ax.grid(False, axis='x')
    ax.spines['top'].set_visible(False)
    ax.spines['right'].set_visible(False)
    ax.spines['left'].set_color('#BDB6AD')
    ax.spines['bottom'].set_color('#BDB6AD')

# Panel 1: costs with fossil benchmark range.
ax1.fill_between(f_years, f_low, f_high, color=colors['fossil_fill'], alpha=0.42,
                 label='New fossil generation range (gas/coal)')
ax1.plot(f_years, f_low, color=colors['fossil'], lw=1.2, alpha=0.7)
ax1.plot(f_years, f_high, color=colors['fossil'], lw=1.2, alpha=0.7)
ax1.plot(years, solar, color=colors['solar'], lw=3.0, marker='o', ms=4.3, label='Solar PV LCOE')
ax1.plot(years, wind, color=colors['wind'], lw=3.0, marker='o', ms=4.3, label='Onshore wind LCOE')
ax1.plot(years, battery, color=colors['battery'], lw=3.0, marker='o', ms=4.3, label='Battery storage LCOE')
ax1.set_yscale('log')
ax1.set_ylim(25, 1300)
ax1.set_ylabel('Levelized cost of energy\n(2023 USD/MWh, log scale)', fontsize=10.5)
ax1.yaxis.set_major_locator(mticker.FixedLocator([30, 50, 100, 200, 500, 1000]))
ax1.yaxis.set_major_formatter(mticker.FuncFormatter(lambda x, pos: f'${int(x):,}'))
ax1.yaxis.set_minor_formatter(mticker.NullFormatter())

# Crossover markers.
for year, series, name, color, yoffset in [
    (solar_cross, solar, 'Solar below fossil low', colors['solar'], 1.45),
    (wind_cross, wind, 'Wind below fossil low', colors['wind'], 0.64),
]:
    y = float(series[np.where(years == year)[0][0]])
    ax1.scatter([year], [y], s=100, color=color, edgecolor='white', linewidth=1.6, zorder=5)
    ax1.axvline(year, color=color, lw=1.1, ls='--', alpha=0.45)
    ax1.annotate(f'{name}\n{year}: ${int(y)}/MWh', xy=(year, y),
                 xytext=(year + 0.35, y * yoffset), fontsize=9.2,
                 ha='left', va='center', color=color, fontweight='bold',
                 arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='-|>', color=color, lw=1.0, shrinkA=2, shrinkB=4))

ax1.annotate('Battery storage cost collapse\n$1,100 → $102/MWh (−91%)',
             xy=(2024, battery[-1]), xytext=(2019.1, 450), fontsize=10,
             ha='left', va='center', color=colors['battery'], fontweight='bold',
             arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='-|>', color=colors['battery'], lw=1.1))
ax1.annotate('Solar PV −91%\nWind −63% since 2010',
             xy=(2024, solar[-1]), xytext=(2020.0, 72), fontsize=9.5,
             ha='left', va='center', color='#3B332C',
             bbox=dict(boxstyle='round,pad=0.35', facecolor='white', edgecolor='#DDD6CC', alpha=0.88))
ax1.legend(loc='upper right', ncol=2, frameon=True, framealpha=0.92, facecolor='white', edgecolor='#DDD6CC', fontsize=9)
ax1.set_title('Clean energy costs plunged below fossil benchmarks while deployment surged',
              loc='left', fontsize=17, pad=12)
ax1.text(0.0, 1.02,
         'Global energy economics, 2010–2024 | Source units: LCOE in 2023 real USD/MWh; capacity in GW; subsidies in nominal billion USD',
         transform=ax1.transAxes, fontsize=9.6, color='#5B534B')

# Panel 2: installed capacity.
ax2.fill_between(cap_years, 0, solar_gw, color=colors['solar'], alpha=0.16)
ax2.fill_between(cap_years, 0, wind_gw, color=colors['wind'], alpha=0.12)
ax2.plot(cap_years, solar_gw, color=colors['solar'], lw=3.0, marker='o', ms=4.1, label='Solar PV cumulative capacity')
ax2.plot(cap_years, wind_gw, color=colors['wind'], lw=3.0, marker='o', ms=4.1, label='Onshore wind cumulative capacity')
ax2.set_ylabel('Cumulative installed\ncapacity (GW)', fontsize=10.5)
ax2.set_ylim(0, 2100)
ax2.yaxis.set_major_locator(mticker.MultipleLocator(500))
ax2.yaxis.set_major_formatter(mticker.FuncFormatter(lambda x, pos: f'{int(x):,}'))
ax2.axvspan(2018, 2024, color=colors['solar'], alpha=0.055, lw=0)
ax2.annotate('Solar acceleration after 2018\n480 → 1,950 GW', xy=(2024, solar_gw[-1]),
             xytext=(2018.2, 1650), ha='left', va='center', fontsize=10,
             color=colors['solar'], fontweight='bold',
             arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='-|>', color=colors['solar'], lw=1.15))
ax2.text(2024.15, solar_gw[-1], '1,950 GW', color=colors['solar'], fontsize=9.2, va='center', fontweight='bold')
ax2.text(2024.15, wind_gw[-1], '960 GW', color=colors['wind'], fontsize=9.2, va='center', fontweight='bold')
ax2.legend(loc='upper left', frameon=True, framealpha=0.92, facecolor='white', edgecolor='#DDD6CC', fontsize=9)
ax2.set_title('Deployment scaled as costs fell', loc='left', fontsize=12.5, pad=6)

# Panel 3: subsidies.
ax3.stackplot(sub_years, cons, prod, colors=[colors['sub_cons'], colors['sub_prod']], alpha=0.88,
              labels=['Consumption subsidies', 'Production subsidies'])
ax3.plot(sub_years, total, color='#4A3622', lw=2.0, label='Total fossil fuel subsidies')
ax3.set_ylabel('Annual fossil fuel\nsubsidies (nominal $bn)', fontsize=10.5)
ax3.set_ylim(0, 760)
ax3.yaxis.set_major_locator(mticker.MultipleLocator(200))
ax3.yaxis.set_major_formatter(mticker.FuncFormatter(lambda x, pos: f'${int(x):,}'))
ax3.scatter([2022], [total[list(sub_years).index(2022)]], s=70, color='#4A3622', edgecolor='white', zorder=5)
ax3.annotate('2022 price-crisis spike\n$700bn', xy=(2022, 700), xytext=(2017.7, 650),
             ha='left', va='center', fontsize=9.5, color='#4A3622', fontweight='bold',
             arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='-|>', color='#4A3622', lw=1.0))
ax3.annotate('Persistent incumbent support\nremains hundreds of billions annually',
             xy=(2024, total[-1]), xytext=(2011.0, 150), fontsize=9.4,
             ha='left', va='center', color='#4A3622',
             bbox=dict(boxstyle='round,pad=0.35', facecolor='white', edgecolor='#DDD6CC', alpha=0.88),
             arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='-|>', color='#4A3622', lw=1.0))
ax3.legend(loc='upper left', ncol=3, frameon=True, framealpha=0.92, facecolor='white', edgecolor='#DDD6CC', fontsize=9)
ax3.set_title('Fossil fuel subsidies stayed large and volatile', loc='left', fontsize=12.5, pad=6)

ax3.set_xlabel('Year', fontsize=11)
ax3.set_xlim(2009.7, 2025.1)
ax3.xaxis.set_major_locator(mticker.FixedLocator([2010, 2012, 2014, 2016, 2018, 2020, 2022, 2024]))
for ax in (ax1, ax2):
    plt.setp(ax.get_xticklabels(), visible=False)

fig.text(0.012, 0.012,
         'Fossil range uses min gas/coal low to max gas/coal high from biennial benchmark data; crossover markers compare annual renewable LCOE with linearly interpolated lower bound.',
         fontsize=8.2, color='#6A625A')

fig.tight_layout(rect=[0.035, 0.035, 0.995, 0.985])
fig.savefig(out, facecolor=fig.get_facecolor(), bbox_inches='tight')
plt.close(fig)
